scope: dataset-only; native SPH trajectory labels and derived observables; no training, inference, checkpoint replay, tuning, ranking, or model qualification

source_evidence.audit_interpretation: D03 Q-I/Q-N evidence is numerical integrity and scope classification only; Q-E and scientific acceptance remain not assessed

identity_key.boundary: The key identifies a numerical SPH node in the exported trajectory. It is never, by itself, a material identity or a material lineage proof.

dimension.position_storage: Always store three components; for a declared 2D case only the source-defined physical plane is interpretable.
dimension.z_coordinate_rule_for_2d: Do not promote a 2D case to 3D because of a nonzero numerical embedding coordinate or a geometric heuristic. Preserve the source/D03 calibration role and audit the declared physical plane.

time.meaning: Saved solver output time for each frame.
not_meaning: not a particle label
not a material residence-time guarantee

particle_id.meaning: Numerical particle identifier exported by PartVTK/trajectory conversion.
not_meaning: not independently established material identity
not a guarantee that a particle remains in the physical system
not a tracer result

particle_zone.meaning: Numerical zone/resolution component of the exported identity key.
not_meaning: not a material region label
not a source-fluid provenance claim
not a substitute for variable-resolution lineage

valid.meaning: Whether the numerical particle key has an exported active row in that frame.
not_meaning: false is not automatically material exit
false is not automatically particle destruction
false is not a zero-valued physical field
false is not proof of an out-of-domain destination

position.meaning: Native solver particle coordinates at valid frames.
not_meaning: not a reconstructed material path when identity is lost
not an external measurement

velocity.meaning: Native solver particle velocity at valid frames.
not_meaning: not prescribed boundary/body control
not a material tracer velocity unless an independent tracer contract is present

density.meaning: Native SPH density estimate exported for the numerical particle.
not_meaning: not external density ground truth
not a material-class label

mass.meaning: Numerical SPH particle mass used for active-particle mass diagnostics.
not_meaning: not sufficient for closed-system conservation in an open lifecycle
not a material mass balance without scope/flux accounting

pressure.meaning: Native solver pressure value exported at valid particle rows.
not_meaning: not externally calibrated pressure
not a material or phase label

type.meaning: DualSPHysics-native particle-role code; values remain version/source dependent.

known_observed_values.2: floating/body-role example in existing converter diagnostics
known_observed_values.3: fluid-role example in existing converter diagnostics

not_meaning: not a material composition label
not a universal enum across every official example
not a substitute for body/geometry provenance

mk.meaning: Numerical source/group partition carried by the solver output.
not_meaning: not material identity
not a validated material tracer
not an automatic source-to-destination mass truth

active_particle_count.interpretation: Numerical active-row count only; changes are expected in open or variable-resolution scopes.

active_mass.interpretation: Mass of active numerical rows; use as a closed invariant only when the lifecycle is explicitly closed.

centroid.interpretation: Unweighted active-particle centroid used by D03; it is not a material-volume centroid unless that weighting and scope are separately defined.

common_identity_displacement.identity_basis: common numerical identity key between first and last valid frames
common_identity_displacement.interpretation: Displacement of retained numerical keys; not a material transport observable when identity/material lineage is unresolved.

max_speed.interpretation: Maximum native numerical-particle speed over valid rows.

density_range.interpretation: Native SPH numerical range, not external validation.

pressure_range.interpretation: Native solver pressure range, not external validation.

identity_retention_initial_to_final.interpretation: Numerical-key retention diagnostic. It must not be called material retention.

introduced_identity_count.interpretation: Numerical keys first observed after the initial frame; in open scopes this is compatible with inlet introduction.

initial_identity_missing_at_final.interpretation: Numerical keys absent at the final frame; do not label them escaped, deposited, destroyed, or lost materially without additional scope evidence.

zone_occupancy.interpretation: Resolution-zone diagnostic; zone is not material provenance.

closed_invariant.formula: Q-I pass ∧ Q-N pass ∧ no introduced key ∧ no initial key missing at final ∧ active-mass-relative-range <= tolerance
closed_invariant.interpretation: A numerical closed-trajectory integrity result only; it does not establish scientific acceptance or material truth.

semantics.dataset_role: Operational role such as candidate, diagnostic, calibration, or exclusion_negative; it is not a model split and does not authorize training.
semantics.scope_decision: D03 numerical/scope classification; preserve diagnostic and negative-control labels.
semantics.dimension: Declared physical dimensionality from the source/case contract; do not infer production eligibility from a position-coordinate heuristic.
semantics.resolution_role: Coarse canary, historical reuse, variable-resolution, 2D calibration, or an explicitly declared production resolution role.
semantics.lifecycle_model: One of closed, open, variable_resolution, calibration_2d, or unknown; it must be explicit before applying a closed mass gate.
semantics.failure_codes: D03 scope and numerical failure/diagnostic codes; an empty list is not scientific acceptance.
semantics.scientific_acceptance: Must remain not_assessed in this dataset-only contract unless an independent owner-approved assessment exists.
semantics.q_e_status: Must remain not_assessed_no_external_measurement_or_ground_truth_bound for the current D03 evidence.

allowed_claims: numerical identity and active-mass closure over the declared window when the invariant passes

trigger_evidence: explicit inlet/outlet or particle introduction/removal in the case contract
allowed_claims: scope-aware flux accounting when separately provided
forbidden_claims: valid=false means material left the system
new numerical key means new material without independent evidence

allowed_claims: zone-aware numerical occupancy and identity diagnostics
forbidden_claims: closed identity invariant without a zone/lineage audit
material mixing labels from zone or Mk

allowed_claims: CPU/model-free schema and evaluator tests if separately scoped
forbidden_claims: silently merging 2D and 3D cases in a production split

missing_value_policy.valid_false: Treat fields as unavailable/censored for that numerical key and frame. Preserve the reason as unknown unless an explicit lifecycle or tracer audit supplies it.
missing_value_policy.inactive_numeric_storage: NaN/fill values may be present outside valid rows; audits apply finite/positive checks only to valid rows.
missing_value_policy.no_event_rule: Missing or invalid rows must never be converted into a confirmed no-event, zero displacement, material escape, or material destruction label.

core_production_boundary.explicit_rule: A case may retain native numerical trajectories and D03 diagnostics without a material tracer. An optional tracer can add a separate diagnostic layer but cannot promote, demote, or gate the core native trajectory by itself.

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not relabel Mk as material identity.
Do not relabel particle_id or (particle_zone, particle_id) as material lineage.
Do not use Type as a universal material or phase enum.
Do not turn valid=false into a material fate label.
Do not apply a closed mass gate to an open-lifecycle case.
Do not use a 2D calibration case as a 3D production acceptance case.
Do not use a variable-resolution trajectory as a material-lineage reference without an independent lineage audit.
Do not require an optional material tracer for native-data production eligibility.
